criteria.description: One full-height hero, top cover image, bottom band, h1, description, labeled email, submit CTA, and legal link; zero nav/logo/video/scrim/second CTA
Top image flexes to the remaining viewport height and meets the bottom band without gap or overlap
Band stacks narrowly and becomes heading-left/content-right; form stacks narrow and becomes a row; no overflow at 320/390/767/768/1280
JS-off keeps owned image, native form action, and real legal destination functional
Visible label/focus, 44px targets, reduced-motion, light/dark contrast, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
